messages.subject: Renewable Energy Leadership | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Executive
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Watson,

Your renewable-energy executive-search work aligns with my leadership profile across energy transition, ESG, government relations and external affairs. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning regulatory and government engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where renewable-energy growth intersects with regulators, communities, investors and strategic partners. I am internationally mobile and open to senior international opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
